name: dsh-opencode-go
description: DeepSeek Harness LLM adapter for OpenCode Go (opencode.ai/zen): /models discovery with cache, three wire protocols (OpenAI Responses, OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions, Anthropic Messages), tool calling, reasoning mapping, streaming, and the required x-opencode-session affinity header.
comment: Zero runtime dependencies on purpose: the adapter implements the harness contract with its own error and brand helpers, so it installs into any DSH version. See lib/error/errors.js.
